parameters.notes: VPA-76. Each listed control was wheeled to both ends in the vendor panel and moved only its own bytes; min/max are the raw limits seen. Raw units: no physical unit is claimed. Bytes of the block not listed here (switches, menus, stacked rings the wheel did not reach) are unmapped and are written back unchanged.
